# libfat (not included)

DSLeaf is linked with **libfat** from devkitPro (https://github.com/devkitPro/libfat), which reads the SD card. Its source is not in this repository. `LICENSE.txt` is the licence notice that libfat's source files carry (the BSD 3-clause licence, Copyright (c) 2006 Michael "Chishm" Chisholm, copied from `source/fatfile.c` of libfat on 2026-11-03). A binary form must reproduce it in its documentation, so DSLeaf's About screen shows it (decision 087).
